cohort: Patients who experienced postoperative adverse events in 387 hospitals throughout Taiwan in 2006
finding: Postoperative adverse events during hospitalization have a major impact on total hospitalization expenditures and length of stay.
mod_finding: The incidence of obstetric trauma with instrument was 132.6 per 1,000 admissions, and the length of stay associated with this adverse event was 0.10 days.
